tools.name: post_task
tools.description: One-call posting path: create an unpaid Invoke human task from title, description, reward_cents, contact_email, and optional category, then return task_id, pending_payment status, platform_fee_cents, and checkout_url to activate it.

tools.name: post_human_task
tools.description: Alias for post_task: create an unpaid Invoke human task and receive the pending task id plus checkout URL for activation.

tools.name: hire_human
tools.description: Alias for post_task: hire a human through Invoke for research, testing, verification, calls, or physical-world work.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: post_human_task · Public sink: post_task, post_human_task.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: post_human_task · Public sink: post_task, post_human_task

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "post_human_task" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Post a paid human task to Invoke and receive the pending task id plus checkout URL for activation." → after: "Alias for post_task: create an unpaid Invoke human task and receive the pending task id plus checkout URL for activation."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
